description: Direct switching-state SHE modulation via the base-image PatternModulator: edges scheduled at exact SHE table angles on TIM1, not duty cycles. Pushes the commanded m/phase/angle to the driver and enables pattern mode when gated active by the sequencer.

inputPorts.name: V_D
inputPorts.description: Commanded d-axis voltage (from the current loop, smooth).

inputPorts.name: V_Q
inputPorts.description: Commanded q-axis voltage (from the current loop, smooth).

inputPorts.name: Dir
inputPorts.description: Raw rotation direction from the encoder driver (+1/-1), before the configured encoder sign.

inputPorts.name: EncSign
inputPorts.description: Configured encoder sign (Motor.Encoder.SinCos.Sign) as used by ElecAngle.

inputPorts.name: ModeFrom
inputPorts.description: Sequencer mode being left / current mode.

outputPorts.name: Duty_A
outputPorts.description: Dummy neutral duty (50%); the pattern driver owns the pins when this mode is active.

outputPorts.name: PatternOn
outputPorts.description: 1 while the pattern modulator owns TIM1 (telemetry).

outputPorts.name: ArmOk
outputPorts.description: 1 while the pattern engine can arm (effective direction forward); feeds the sequencer's mode-2 availability gate.

EncSign.description: Fallback encoder sign when the EncSign input is not wired.

ModeId.description: This modulator's slot in the sequencer ladder (SHE = 2).

NPulses.description: SHE pulse number per quarter wave (v1: 5).
